ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Shield
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried more of the colony's people out of a fight than anyone, with the fighting still going on around {PAWN_objective}. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Shield.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: {PAWN_nameDef} carried more of the colony out of the fighting than anyone. In the next fight, whoever falls will have to hope someone else comes for them.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Night-Watch
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has walked the walls through more nights than anyone, and is still out there when the others come out at dawn. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Night-Watch.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: The colony will sleep less easily without {PAWN_nameDef} on the walls.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Champion
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Whatever the contest, a wrestle at a feast or a test of hands against a friend, {PAWN_nameDef} wins it more often than anyone here. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Champion, and the challengers keep coming.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Master-Hand
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: More of the colony's finest pieces came out of {PAWN_nameDef}'s hands than anyone's: the kind people stop and look at twice. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Master-Hand.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: The finest things in the colony were made by {PAWN_nameDef}. They will outlast {PAWN_objective} by a long way.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Lamp
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: When the sickbeds fill, {PAWN_nameDef} goes round them, one bed after another, more often than anyone. The sick brighten when {PAWN_pronoun} comes in, and the colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Lamp.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: The sick will miss {PAWN_nameDef} at their bedsides more than anyone.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Open-Hand
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Water for a thirsty traveler, a meal for a refugee, a long talk at a stranger's fire: {PAWN_nameDef} has done more strangers a kindness than anyone here. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Open-Hand.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Teacher
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: More of the colony's people learned their work at {PAWN_nameDef}'s elbow than at anyone else's, and now get on with it alone. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Teacher.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: Some of what {PAWN_nameDef} knew lives on in the hands of the ones {PAWN_pronoun} taught.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Hopeful
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has stood for the council and lost more often than anyone, and stands again every time. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Hopeful, mostly kindly.
